fields.instructions: Where the advert sends the reader. Leave blank to show the banner without a link.

fields.instructions: Used as the image description for screen readers and search engines.

fields.label: Advertising — ad network code
fields.name: ads_code
fields.instructions: Only for adverts served by a network such as Google AdSense. Paste the code the network gives you. It is used instead of the banners above, so leave this blank while you are selling adverts yourself. Only site Administrators should paste code here.

fields.label: Advertising background colour

fields.name: caricature_1_caption
fields.instructions: A sentence or two explaining what the cartoon is commenting on.

fields.label: Caricature 1 — artist credit
fields.name: caricature_1_artist
fields.instructions: The cartoonist's name. Always credit the artist.

fields.label: Caricature 2 — image
fields.name: caricature_2_image
fields.instructions: The second cartoon. Leave blank to show caricature 1 on its own.

fields.label: Caricature — link
fields.name: caricature_link
fields.instructions: Optional. Links the cartoon to a related article or an archive of past cartoons.

title: About Page Content

fields.label: Page title
fields.name: about_title
fields.default_value: An institution built on the conviction that ideas transform civilizations

fields.label: Subtitle
fields.name: about_subtitle
fields.default_value: Ideas. Evidence. Wisdom. Africa. — the four words that discipline everything we publish.

fields.label: Banner background colour
fields.name: about_banner_bg_color
fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the site's brand colour.

fields.label: Intro background colour
fields.name: about_intro_bg_color
fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the site's brand colour.

fields.label: Vision text
fields.name: vision_text
fields.default_value: To become Africa's most trusted independent institution for ideas, scholarship, and public discourse — advancing an intellectual renaissance that shapes ethical leadership, resilient institutions, technological innovation, and sustainable development.

fields.label: Vision note
fields.name: vision_note
fields.default_value: Trust is more valuable than popularity. Influence is more enduring than visibility.

fields.label: Mission text
fields.name: mission_text
fields.default_value: To cultivate rigorous analysis, independent thought, and evidence-based dialogue that strengthens Africa's intellectual life, informs public policy, and equips society to address the defining challenges of the 21st century.

fields.label: Mission note
fields.name: mission_note
fields.default_value: Every article should educate. Every publication should illuminate. Every debate should elevate.

fields.label: Vision & Mission background colour
fields.name: vm_bg_color
fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the site's brand colour.

fields.label: Step 1 — text
fields.name: story_1_text
fields.default_value: Africa's public discourse is too often dominated by immediate events rather than enduring principles — news rewards speed over reflection, opinion over evidence.

fields.label: Step 2 — text
fields.name: story_2_text
fields.default_value: ARR was founded in direct response to this challenge: to cultivate thoughtful analysis and evidence-based dialogue rooted in African realities.

fields.label: Step 3 — text
fields.name: story_3_text
fields.default_value: Not a daily wire service, but a home for depth — long-form essays, research translation, and ideas built to outlast the headlines that inspired them.

fields.label: Story background colour
fields.name: story_bg_color
fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the site's brand colour.

fields.label: Section subheading
fields.name: pillars_sub
fields.default_value: Seven pillars define the intellectual identity of ARR

fields.label: Pillars background colour
fields.name: pillars_bg_color
fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the site's brand colour.

fields.label: Value 1 — text
fields.name: value_1_text
fields.default_value: The foundation of public trust, pursued with disciplined research and honesty.

fields.label: Value 2 — text
fields.name: value_2_text
fields.default_value: Editorial judgment free from partisan, commercial, or ideological influence.

fields.label: Value 3 — text
fields.name: value_3_text
fields.default_value: Continuous learning and work that meets the highest international standards.

fields.label: Value 4 — text
fields.name: value_4_text
fields.default_value: Consistency between principle and practice across every process.

fields.label: Value 5 — text
fields.name: value_5_text
fields.default_value: Openness to dialogue, recognising that reasonable people may disagree.

fields.label: Value 6 — text
fields.name: value_6_text
fields.default_value: Publishing what is true and necessary, even when it is uncomfortable.

fields.label: Values background colour

title: Contribute Page Content

fields.label: Page subtitle
fields.name: contribute_subtitle
fields.default_value: ARR publishes rigorous, evidence-based writing on the questions shaping Africa. If that is the work you want to do, tell us about it.

fields.label: Form intro line
fields.name: contribute_form_intro
fields.default_value: Every application is read by an editor. There is no form letter and no automated rejection.

fields.label: Fine print below the button
fields.name: contribute_fineprint
fields.default_value: We use your details only to reply to this application. They are not stored on the website and never shared.

fields.label: Step 1 — text
fields.name: contribute_step_1_text
fields.default_value: Send the form with a short note on the subjects you follow and how you would approach them.

fields.label: Step 2 — text
fields.name: contribute_step_2_text
fields.default_value: We look for command of the subject and a clear argument, not a long list of credits.

fields.label: Step 3 — text
fields.name: contribute_step_3_text
fields.default_value: Accepted contributors get a login and can draft directly on the site. An editor reviews each piece before it publishes.

fields.label: Side panel closing note
fields.name: contribute_note
fields.default_value: Already write for ARR? Sign in to start a new draft.

fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the site's brand colour.
